title: Understanding Contour Plots
text: Contour plots are used to represent three-dimensional data in two dimensions. The contour lines connect points of equal value, often representing density or height.

title: Contour Plot Characteristics
text: What do contour lines in a contour plot represent?

title: Density in Contour Plots
text: In contour plots, lines that are close together indicate a steep gradient, while lines that are far apart indicate a gentle gradient. This can help in understanding the distribution of data points.
